title: smime-tree: implement sign()
description: Signing is a core S/MIME operation. Implement in sign.rs: build SignedData structure; compute digest over content_mime bytes; call key.sign() for the signature; embed signer cert; encode as ContentInfo DER; wrap in multipart/signed MIME with correct boundary and Content-Type parameters per RFC 5751. The signed bytes must be exactly the canonical MIME part bytes (no re-encoding).
acceptance_criteria: sign() output is accepted by openssl smime -verify; Content-Type header has correct micalg parameter
